bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears have agreed to acquire a 2027 fifth-round pick and defensive back Clark Phillips III from the Atlanta Falcons in exchange for defensive lineman Gervon Dexter Sr., pending physicals. Meanwhile, as the team prepares for its Week 1 opener against the Panthers, general manager Ryan Poles gave an encouraging update on injured left tackle Ozzy Trapilo and praised quarterback Caleb Williams' progress heading into the season.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions placed running back Isiah Pacheco on injured reserve as part of a series of roster moves, with Pacheco set to be eligible for activation off IR ahead of Detroit's Week 5 matchup against Arizona . Meanwhile, the team also made moves at other positions, as the Lions waived Seth McLaughlin, leaving them no choice but to put all their faith in Juice Scruggs at center , while Jahmyr Gibbs was named among six Lions selected to the 2026 NFL Top 100.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Packers' biggest news is running back Josh Jacobs being placed on paid administrative leave via the NFL's Commissioner's Exempt List amid assault allegations, which has opened a big door for MarShawn Lloyd in Green Bay to step up in the backfield. GM Brian Gutekunst is hopeful the three-time Pro Bowl running back plays this season, but he told reporters Tuesday that Green Bay will "be prepared either way."

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
